'hero/skill/6011/1',"King calls the royal legion, summoning ${cfg.args.Number} Royal Guards and ${cfg.args.Number1} Royal Archers. Royal legion exists for ${cfg.args.duration/1000} seconds. Royal legion's stats grow as King levels up."

"hero/skill/6011/2","King calls the royal legion, summoning ${cfg.args.Number} Royal Guards and ${cfg.args.Number1} Royal Archers. Royal legion exists for ${cfg.args.duration/1000} seconds, and they recover ${cfg.args.healRate}% HP per sec when out of combat. Royal legion's stats grow as King levels up."

"hero/skill/6011/3","King calls the royal legion, summoning ${cfg.args.Number} Royal Guards and ${cfg.args.Number1} Royal Archers. Royal legion exists for ${cfg.args.duration/1000} seconds, and they recover ${cfg.args.healRate}% HP per sec when out of combat. King gains ${cfg.args.defence}% DMG Reduction for each soldier on the field. Royal legion's stats grow as King levels up."
"hero/skill/6007/1","亡灵术士从地狱召唤一只小型恶魔协助攻击，并帮英雄承担${cfg.args.shareDMG}%所受伤害，恶魔持续存在直至死亡。（恶魔的等级与亡灵术士的等级相关）"
'hero/skill/6007/2',"亡灵术士从地狱召唤一只中型恶魔协助攻击，并帮英雄承担${cfg.args.shareDMG}%所受伤害，恶魔获得攻击吸血，持续存在直至死亡。（恶魔的等级与亡灵术士的等级相关）"
"hero/skill/6007/3","亡灵术士从地狱召唤一只大型恶魔协助攻击，并帮英雄承担${cfg.args.shareDMG}%所受伤害，恶魔获得控制免疫及攻击吸血，持续存在直至死亡。（恶魔的等级与亡灵术士的等级相关）"
"hero/skill/6011/1",'国王呼叫皇家军团，召唤${cfg.args.Number}名皇家近卫和${cfg.args.Number1}名皇家弓手，皇家军团存在${cfg.args.duration/1000}秒（皇家军团的等级与国王的等级相关）'
"hero/skill/6011/2","国王呼叫皇家军团，召唤${cfg.args.Number}名皇家近卫和${cfg.args.Number1}名皇家弓手，皇家军团存在${cfg.args.duration/1000}秒。脱战时皇家军团每秒恢复${cfg.args.healRate}%血量。（皇家军团的等级与国王的等级相关）"

"hero/skill/6011/3","国王呼叫皇家军团，召唤${cfg.args.Number}名皇家近卫和${cfg.args.Number1}名皇家弓手，皇家军团存在${cfg.args.duration/1000}秒。脱战时皇家军团每秒恢复${cfg.args.healRate}%血量。每有一名士兵在场上时，国王获得${cfg.args.defence}%减伤。（皇家军团的等级与国王的等级相关）"
